title: NullPointerException in UserService after OAuth token refresh
stack_trace:
NullPointerException at UserService.java:142
  user.getAccountId() returned null after token refresh
root_cause: OAuth refresh handler rebuilds User object but omits accountId mapping
resolution: Re-map all user fields in OAuthRefreshHandler.refreshUserContext(). Add null guard before getAccountId() call.

title: Database connection pool exhausted under high load
stack_trace:
TimeoutException: Unable to acquire connection from pool
  at HikariPool.getConnection(HikariPool.java:213)
root_cause: Connection pool max-size too low for concurrent request volume
resolution: Increased HikariCP pool size from 10 to 25 in application.properties.

title: JWT token expiry not handled â€” returns 500 instead of 401
stack_trace:
SignatureVerificationException at JWTFilter.java:88
  Token signature verification failed
root_cause: JWTFilter throws uncaught exception on token expiry instead of returning 401
resolution: Added try-catch in JWTFilter, return ResponseEntity with 401 status.

title: API rate limiter blocking legitimate requests after cache flush
stack_trace:
RateLimitException: Request limit exceeded for IP 192.168.1.1
  at RateLimiterService.checkLimit(RateLimiterService.java:56)
root_cause: Redis cache flush resets rate limiter counters incorrectly
resolution: Added fallback in-memory counter during Redis reconnection.

title: Scheduler job runs twice on application restart
stack_trace:
DuplicateKeyException: Duplicate entry for job execution log
  at SchedulerService.executeJob(SchedulerService.java:112)
root_cause: Quartz scheduler not properly deregistered before shutdown
resolution: Added scheduler.shutdown(true) in pre-destroy hook. Added idempotency check.

title: Memory leak in file upload handler â€” heap grows unbounded
root_cause: File chunks stored in memory without streaming to disk
resolution: Switched to streaming multipart processing. Chunks written directly to temp file.

title: Pagination returns duplicate records on page boundary
stack_trace: No exception â€” silent data issue. Page 2 returns last 2 records of page 1.
root_cause: OFFSET-based pagination with non-deterministic ORDER BY on equal timestamps
resolution: Added secondary sort on ID. Switched to cursor-based pagination.

title: Email notification service sends duplicate emails on retry
root_cause: Retry logic does not check if email was already delivered before retrying
resolution: Added idempotency key per email event. Check delivery status before retry.

title: Frontend crashes on null user profile after logout-login cycle
stack_trace:
TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'displayName')
  at UserProfile.render (UserProfile.jsx:34)
root_cause: Redux store not cleared on logout â€” stale user object persists
resolution: Dispatch CLEAR_USER action on logout. Reset entire auth slice before new login.

title: Search index not updated after bulk record delete
stack_trace:
IndexOutOfSyncException: Document IDs in search index do not match database
  at SearchIndexService.verify(SearchIndexService.java:201)
root_cause: Bulk delete bypasses Hibernate event listeners â€” search index sync hook never triggered
resolution: Replaced bulk delete with batched individual deletes to trigger listeners.

title: Password reset link expires before user clicks it
stack_trace:
TokenExpiredException: Reset token has expired
  at PasswordResetService.validateToken(PasswordResetService.java:78)
  at AuthController.resetPassword(AuthController.java:134)
  -- Token generated with 15 minute expiry but email delivery takes 20+ minutes
root_cause: Password reset token TTL set to 15 minutes but email delivery through the SMTP relay averages 20-25 minutes during peak hours, causing tokens to expire before the user receives and clicks the link
resolution: Increased token TTL from 15 minutes to 60 minutes in application.properties. Added token expiry time display in the email body so users know how long they have
